answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols utilize economic staking to secure a decentralized harbor for AI agents. By requiring validators to lock capital, the system imposes a cost on identity proliferation that grows with each additional node. The delta between the cost of capital and expected rewards disincentivizes Sybil attacks, effectively pruning the malicious garden of fake accounts. An attacker faces prohibitive financial risk, as acquiring enough influence necessitates massive, locked collateral rather than mere software replication.
